title: In the kitchen: what you cook in, and what you cook with
note: B1 Oxford-gap leaf · vessels and portions, then the forms food comes in and what you do to them · 12 items · carriers via use[] · picture intro · Use bank

intro.title: The kitchen words a recipe assumes you know
intro.title_cz: Slova z kuchyně, která recept předpokládá
intro.body: A recipe rarely names the food you already know — it names the container, the portion and the action, and assumes the rest. Half of these words are things you hold; the other half describe what the food is doing when you hold it.

intro.title: You will use these words in
intro.note: powder, grain and liquid are uncountable — a spoon of powder, not a powder. pot, pan, container, slice and layer are countable and take a or the.
intro.note_cz: powder, grain, liquid = nepočitatelná, bez členu a. pot, pan, container, slice, layer = počitatelná.
